text: Part 2 of the fix for job 20261024-140624-ewbs: pr_commits in crates/athena-core/src/land.rs must stop reading Athena-Job trailers and classify each commit between the remote base and the PR head by its content, setting LandingCommit's kind (added in b6f22c2): a commit that leaves governed content unchanged (the gate's fingerprint, as crates/athena-gate's invariant computes it) is records_only; a commit that adds an intervention record under records/interventions/ is declared_intervention; a commit that adds a job's closing records (its candidate, verification and landed outcome) is that job's job_landing, with that job and verification; any other commit that changes governed content is refused with an error naming its sha. Replace the trailer-count tests with a test on a range shaped like this repository's real pull requests (reading, dispatch and introspection commits, a lease commit under operator/, an intervention, then the job's landing, none with an Athena-Job trailer) and a refusal test. Run only the athena-core land and gh tests you need while working.
